extracted.name: Sour Cream Waffles
extracted.description: These waffles substitute sour cream and yogurt for milk. The inspiration came about one morning when there was no milk in the house.
instruction_lines: In a bowl, mix together water, sour cream, yogurt, and vinegar.
Sift flour into a separate, large bowl; stir in baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add sour cream mixture and eggs to flour mixture; blend until smooth.
Cook on a lightly greased waffle iron until golden brown; lift off with a fork.
